soldier: Soldier head pale yellowish brown with the frontal region slightly deeper, mandibles brown tinged with red and the mandibular bases yellowish brown, labrum yellowish brown, pronotum and legs pale yellowish white, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.61–0.64, the sides parallel, the posterolateral corners broadly rounded, the middle of the posterior margin nearly straight. In lateral view the frontal ridge is slightly raised and the top of the frons flat; behind the fontanelle a pale yellow U-shaped cephalic suture extends to the eye spots, clearly dividing the frontal region; both the compound eyes and the ocellar spots are discernible. The labrum is spear-shaped, its apex blunt and rounded, bearing apical and subapical hairs, the lateral-apical hairs reduced or absent. The mandibles are strong, their apices rather strongly curved, the ridge-like process at the mandibular base clearly visible, the inner margin of the right mandible bearing a small tooth scar behind the midpoint; the mandibular length about 0.52–0.56 times the head capsule length and about 0.85–0.90 times the head width. Antennae with 16 segments, segment 3 the shortest. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-fifth, the waist region broad and long with the sides almost parallel, the waist constriction index 0.39–0.43. The pronotum is 1.50–1.70 times as wide as long, the anterior margin formed by two broad intersecting arcs, the middle of the posterior margin very shallowly concave, with about ten or more hairs in the middle region.
